headline: HD Fire Protect opens tomorrow — the pick of the week. Tonbo and Sahajanand are listing-gain plays only.

hd-fire-protect.category_note: 1 lot per family PAN; recheck on 15 Oct
hd-fire-protect.summary: India's #2 fire-protection equipment maker and largest exporter (sprinklers, deluge valves, foam systems), with the most UL/FM certifications among Indian peers.
hd-fire-protect.financials: FY26 revenue ₹489 Cr (+13%), PAT ₹117 Cr, EBITDA margin 31%, debt-free
positives: Certification moat and 30% RoE; priced at 40.7x vs peer average 63x
red_flags: 100% OFS — promoters selling, company gets nothing
₹196 Cr dividends to promoters in the last two years
PAT growth slowed to 6% in FY26; inventory days rising
hd-fire-protect.anchor: Anchor bidding done today; allocation not public yet

tonbo-imaging.category_note: only if the anchor book is strong
tonbo-imaging.summary: Bengaluru defence-electronics maker: thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, targeting and missile-seeker systems; ~71% of revenue from the Indian government.
tonbo-imaging.financials: FY26 revenue ₹363 Cr (−23%), PAT ₹51 Cr (−30%); Q1 FY27 loss ₹17.7 Cr
positives: Owned, ITAR-free technology; #1 in Indian thermal imaging; ₹314 Cr order book
Very strong GMP (~49%) and defence-theme demand
red_flags: Revenue and profit falling; operating cash flow negative two years running
Working-capital days 517; inventory tripled in two years
79x P/E on falling earnings; 100% OFS; promoters hold only 17%

sahajanand-medical-technologies.summary: Surat-based maker of cardiac stents and structural-heart devices (TAVI, occluders); ~25% share of India's drug-eluting stent market, ~39% revenue from Europe.
sahajanand-medical-technologies.financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,211 Cr (+18%), PAT ₹69 Cr (5.7% margin); FY24 was a loss
positives: Real product franchise with 16% revenue CAGR and improving margins
red_flags: 53x P/E vs 44x peers on thin 14% EBITDA margin
Net debt/EBITDA 4.9x; Q1 operating cash flow negative
100% OFS with PE funds exiting; Delhi Police and CBI notices seeking documents

fusion-cx.summary: Customer-experience / BPO services company. RHP not on SEBI yet — full analysis on the next run after it is filed.

zetwerk.summary: Manufacturing-services marketplace; loss-making. RHP not on SEBI yet.

bonfiglioli-transmissions.summary: Industrial gearboxes and drives (Indian arm of Italy's Bonfiglioli). RHP not on SEBI yet.

jio-platforms.summary: Reliance's digital/telecom arm. Dates and price band not announced yet.

notes: Fusion CX, Zetwerk and Bonfiglioli will be analysed as soon as their RHPs appear on SEBI.
